title: Legal & Licenses
intro: Mythgate 5e Companion is an independent 5e companion app. This page collects the license notices used for rules-reference content.

srd.title: SRD 5.1 / OGL 1.0a
srd.body: Some rules-reference content may be derived from SRD 5.1 and used under the Open Game License version 1.0a. The app uses neutral 5e terminology and does not use Product Identity as app branding.

productIdentity.title: Product Identity
productIdentity.body: Mythgate 5e Companion does not present itself as an official product and does not use protected tabletop roleplaying brands as public app branding.
